title: Separate explicit stock and unresolved concentration aliases from pure-solute identity
body:
Five retained aliases need preparation-stage scope review. `Fe(III)-EDTA (0.66% [wt/vol] in water)` explicitly names an aqueous formulation, while four other concentration-qualified strings may denote a stock or a receiving-medium dose. The latter four are not asserted to be proven wrong solely because they contain a concentration.

Keep the explicit aqueous FeIII-EDTA formulation distinct from the pure-solute owner. Recover the exact original stock-versus-dose context for the other four labels before deciding whether each may resolve. Preserve text, occurrence lineage and supported new aliases. Do not create a stock from concentration text alone, infer titrant/solvent amounts, reject every parenthetical concentration, or change the native synonym policy. The already-filtered bare parenthetical solution string is outside this defect.

The exact field/value hashes, original source tags and complete occurrence-evidence pointers are preserved in `ACTIONABLE-MATRIX.json` CH-06. The listed proposal links expose the retained literals; no supplier page is being presented as proof of a source recipe’s stock stage.

Deduplication: #1189 tracks four different W10 owners and is not exact coverage for these five literals. #1201 may track resulting source completion; it does not establish stock identity. No matching stock/owner tracker was found in the captured all-state bodies and relevant indexed search/comments.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
